notes.title: Difficulty Settings & Landing Assistance Update
notes.content:
[list][*][p][b]Difficulty setting added[/b]: Players can now choose "Easy" or "Hard" before starting a game. Easy mode includes checkpoints in certain areas of the map, hard mode has none.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579957/b4abaa79b6e986cb9837c89e46b6dcf6fe48ffc3.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Landing Assistance option added[/b]: Found in settings to help players land on narrow platforms more easily.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579957/97ebbc4b6fe91d2ab7cd9694bcb3ea2b03537040.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Scoreboard visibility improved[/b]: Moved to the top-left corner for easier on-screen score tracking.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579957/f8df84f6f3b038ba218406028986a72f737d82d3.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Player name tags refined[/b]: Positioning and visibility fixed—names are now more legible and stable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor FOV & sensitivity fixes[/b]: Issues related to changing field of view and sensitivity settings have been resolved for smoother adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map selection info added[/b]: A new map info section was added to the map selection screen so players can see details about current and upcoming maps.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collision issues fixed on maps[/b]: Small collision bugs where players could get stuck or pass through platforms have been corrected.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Difficulty setting added: Players can now choose "Easy" or "Hard" before starting a game. Easy mode includes checkpoints in certain areas of the map, hard mode has none.
Landing Assistance option added: Found in settings to help players land on narrow platforms more easily.
Scoreboard visibility improved: Moved to the top-left corner for easier on-screen score tracking.

tags.bug: Player name tags refined: Positioning and visibility fixed—names are now more legible and stable.
Minor FOV & sensitivity fixes: Issues related to changing field of view and sensitivity settings have been resolved for smoother adjustments.

tags.feature: Map selection info added: A new map info section was added to the map selection screen so players can see details about current and upcoming maps.

tags.bug: Collision issues fixed on maps: Small collision bugs where players could get stuck or pass through platforms have been corrected.
